item.title: OR in Medicine and Health Care
item.content:encoded:
Eva K. Lee, Georgia Institute of Technology

Ariela Sofer, George Mason University

This special section seeks research that applies optimization and computational methods to medical and biological problems. The initiative recognizes that healthcare complexity and data-rich biological systems require rigorous mathematical and algorithmic approaches to advance treatment and prevention strategies.

Contributions should address theoretical or methodological developments in optimization models and algorithms, including continuous, integer, combinatorial, and stochastic methods, with direct applications to healthcare delivery, disease management, medical imaging, and biological research. The special section welcomes partnerships between operations research and medical communities to solve problems benefiting public health.

Appel publié par Annals of Operations Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Continuous linear and nonlinear optimization applied to medical and biological applications
  • Integer programming for disease modeling, medical diagnosis, and treatment planning
  • Combinatorial optimization in biological and medical imaging
  • Stochastic approaches to epidemiology and molecular biology
  • Medical device and delivery systems optimization
  • Complex decision problems in clinical applications
